The Pahath-Moab clan was one of the largest groups to return from Babylon: 2,812 members in Zerubbabel's return (Ezra 2:6; Neh 7:11) and additional members under Ezra (Ezra 8:4). Some of its men were among those who had married foreign wives and agreed to send them away (Ezra 10:30). Hashub son of Pahath-Moab helped repair the Jerusalem wall and the Tower of the Ovens (Neh 3:11), and the clan sealed the covenant renewal (Neh 10:14)."
